name: Avocado ice cream
summary: Blended avocado dessert, eaten cold from a cup at the market counters and the night stalls.
origin: A sweet sold around Da Lat Market, the blended avocado dessert with the market stalls.
howToEat: Eat it standing at the counter while it is still cold.
where: Counters on the Da Lat Market slope, at the night market, and at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi.
In Da Nang, the Con Market snack row at 290 Hùng Vương, with bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo, ốc hút, and chè. The hall opens about 06:00–19:00.
priceBand: 20,000–30,000 VND at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi, Da Lat (food-tour note). Da Nang: Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Avocado ice cream — Da Lat kem bo
seoDescription: Kem bơ, blended avocado eaten cold from a cup, at Da Lat Market and the night stalls, and in the Con Market snack row in Da Nang.
